raw_constraint_text:
## Constraints



- $1 \leq T \leq 100000$
- $3 \leq N \leq 500000$
- $|x_i|, |y_i| \leq 1000000000$
- All input values are integers.
- $p_0, p_1, \dots, p_{N-1}$ are the distinct vertices of a strictly convex polygon in counterclockwise order.
- The sum of $N$ over all test cases does not exceed $500000$.
